evidence.reason: Outbox.acknowledge only checks value["id"] against remote_ids and writes an id-only ack; it never compares the retained payload with the fetched record. A retained event whose id is already remote but whose payload was changed after spooling is therefore acknowledged and then hidden by pending(), silently dropping the changed payload. The existing spool replay-conflict check covers re-spooling, not this replay path. Unchanged replays still acknowledge without another push, so the payload comparison is a compatible integrity fix rather than a new requirement.
